With this on, task steps and the final answer are posted to the one Hub session you join, including text read from the screen. Screenshots stay on the phone unless you turn uploads on. The token stays on this phone and is not written into the session.
While a task runs, write each step into the joined session
One session for this phone. The phone joins a topic the Hub owner already created. It does not create a session.

If the token is empty, alias and type are sent once through the Hub MCP tool diaodu_connect. The phone keeps the token and agent id. Do not put the token or API keys into a task.

On Hub, create a Topic and copy its code, or a one-time worker invite. The phone joins through the same MCP server other agents use. It does not create a session. Later tasks keep writing into that same session.

On after you join. Only instructions from the owner of this session are run, the same way as chat. Payments, transfers, deletion, messages to other people, and password entry still ask you on this phone.

Off. Turning this on does not run remote tasks yet. Payments, red packets, transfers, deletion, messages to other people, and password entry will always ask you on this phone. Only the owner of this session can give instructions.

Put related notes into context before planning
Append steps that worked. Failures are marked as pitfalls
Each run becomes a Markdown note you can open on this phone or on the Mac
No knowledge base yet. Choose a folder first; reading, writing and the test do nothing until then. Without one, tasks neither read notes nor write results back.

An Obsidian folder is the only long-term notebook. Each task reads related notes first and, after it succeeds, writes what worked. The chat shows which notes were read and written. No Obsidian plugin is required. Notes go in a subfolder (AgentReins by default), so an existing raw/wiki layout is left in place.
Obsidian is installed. Choose its vault folder. No plugin is required.
You can use a folder without Obsidian. If you install Obsidian later, open that folder as a vault to read the notes.
The system folder picker can create a new folder. Create it, then select it.
If you skip, tasks will not read notes or write results back. Chat and phone control still work. You can add a folder later in Settings › Knowledge base.
Folder permission expired. Choose it again
No notes in this folder yet

Notes in the vault, and which runs read or wrote them

Notes stay inside the subfolder you choose. Run logs go in raw/runs, reusable steps in wiki. Passwords, payment PINs, codes and tokens are not written. Plain Obsidian can open them; Auto LLM Wiki can use AgentReins/raw as Raw and AgentReins/wiki as Wiki.

After connecting, the assistant can run a one-off background job on the server and look it up by task id. The job can continue if the phone disconnects. It does not resume after a server reboot, and there is no scheduler yet.
